articles.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo Calls First Time Playing Against Bucks 'Just Another Game'
articles.summary: Giannis Antetokounmpo will face the Milwaukee Bucks for the first time in his career on Wednesday. Antetokounmpo was traded to the Miami Heat this past offseason after 13 seasons in Milwaukee and said he plans to treat the matchup at Kaseya Center like any other game.
